verified_claims.claim: 本研究为第一个在 quartet/doublet 两个自旋态上同时详细表征 Cpd I 辅助的酶催化环氧→氧杂环丁烷重排的计算研究
verified_claims.source_locator: 原文 PDF 物理页 4，"this present report may, however, be the first elaborate computational study"
verified_claims.evidence: 原文逐字原文表述为第一个 elaborate computational study

verified_claims.claim: Cpd I 的 Fe-O 与 Fe-S 键长：HS (LS) 分别为 1.626 (1.624) Å 与 2.533 (2.539) Å
verified_claims.source_locator: 原文 PDF 物理页 2，"The Fe−O and Fe−S bond distances in the iron-oxo complex (Cpd I) are found to be 1.626 (1.624) and 2.533 (2.539) Å, respectively, for the HS (LS) state"

verified_claims.claim: 环氧化活化能：HS 第一步 EA 8.9、EH 9.8 kcal mol⁻¹；HS 第二步 EA 1.3、EH 0.5 kcal mol⁻¹；LS 单步 EA 与 EH 均为 10.0 kcal mol⁻¹
verified_claims.source_locator: 原文 PDF 物理页 4，"The activation free energy for the first step is 8.9 kcal mol⁻¹ for 4¹ (EA pathway) and 9.8 kcal mol⁻¹ for 4I (EH pathway), whereas the second step involves an activation energy of 1.3 kcal mol⁻¹ for 4¹ and 0.5 kcal mol⁻¹ for 4I...The activation energy value is 10.0 kcal mol⁻¹ for both the EA and the EH pathways"

verified_claims.claim: 重排第一步活化能：EA 路径 HS 27.3、LS 22.3 kcal mol⁻¹；EH 路径 HS 30.6、LS 22.1 kcal mol⁻¹；无催化路径 EA 35.0、EH 46.1 kcal mol⁻¹
verified_claims.source_locator: 原文 PDF 物理页 4-5，"the barrier is 27.3 kcal mol⁻¹ for the HS surface and 22.3 kcal mol⁻¹ for the LS surface along the EA pathway. On the EH pathway, the barriers are 30.6 kcal mol⁻¹ for HS and 22.1 kcal mol⁻¹ for LS"以及"the barriers encountered in the uncatalyzed rearrangement (35.0 kcal mol⁻¹ for EA and 46.1 kcal mol⁻¹ for EH)"

verified_claims.claim: 质子催化路径 EA 28.9、EH 19.7 kcal mol⁻¹，且与酶催化 LS 表面 (EA 22.3、EH 22.1) 对比
verified_claims.source_locator: 原文 PDF 物理页 6，"The activation energy is found to be 28.9 kcal mol⁻¹ for the EA pathway...On the ene-hydroxy surface, surprisingly, the proton-catalyzed pathway has an activation free energy of 19.7 kcal mol⁻¹"

verified_claims.claim: O9-C2 键长在 ²TS₃₋₄ 与 ⁴TS₃₋₄ 中分别为 2.019 Å 与 1.835 Å，⁴TS₃₋₄ 高于 ²TS₃₋₄ 10.8 kcal mol⁻¹，⁴I₄ 高于 ²I₄ 18.5 kcal mol⁻¹
verified_claims.source_locator: 原文 PDF 物理页 7，"The major change in bond distance is observed for the O9−C2 bond (²TS₃₋₄: 2.019 Å; ⁴TS₃₋₄: 1.835 Å). Therefore, 4TS3−4 is a late transition state compared to the 2TS3−4. Energetically 4TS3−4 is 10.8 kcal mol⁻¹ higher than 2TS3−4. The resulting intermediate, 4I4, is 18.5 kcal mol⁻¹ higher in energy than 2I4."

verified_claims.claim: EH 路径重排第二步 ⁴TS_IV-V 高于 ²TS_IV-V 14.7 kcal mol⁻¹；EA 路径重排第二步 ⁴TS₄₋₅ 高于 ²TS₄₋₅ 12.3 kcal mol⁻¹

verified_claims.claim: 热力学 ΔG_I-III：LS 比 HS 在 EH 路径低 3.7 kcal mol⁻¹；ΔG_I-V：EH 路径 −14.2 kcal mol⁻¹，EA 路径 −3.9 kcal mol⁻¹
